concepts.name: Seated charcoal — editorial portrait
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: high-end photographic portrait for this man's engineering portfolio hero, no website layout.
Input images: Image 1 outdoor black-kurta selfie is the PRIMARY FACE reference. Image 2 gray-kurta close-up is supporting identity reference. The subject must be recognizably this exact man, with his natural facial proportions, dark brown eyes, eyebrows, moustache, sparse short beard, cheek mark and voluminous loosely swept black hair. Use the facial look and hair character from these casual photos rather than a generic business headshot. Do not use any blue wedding-suit face or previous generated portrait as reference. Remove selfie lens distortion and filters; retain real age, warm natural skin, and distinctive features. No face slimming or generic model substitution.
Request: an exceptionally stylish, commanding but approachable portrait of the same person in a premium perfectly tailored THREE-PIECE suit: open jacket, clearly visible buttoned matching waistcoat and matching tailored trousers. Thick luxurious matte fine wool, elegant peak lapels, white shirt, beautifully tied dark textured tie, small ivory pocket square. A composed relaxed expression, closed mouth with a hint of warmth, calm alert eyes. Slightly lifted chin, no exaggerated smile, majestic through posture and beautiful photography rather than royal props.
Photography: luxury fashion editorial, natural realistic skin and individual hair detail, 85mm portrait perspective, professionally styled yet recognizable swept hairstyle with no strands hiding eyes. Sharp face and both eyes, broad soft neutral key light fully illuminating the face, gentle sculptural contrast, no face obscured in shadow, no airbrushing or plastic skin. Anatomically accurate hands and body.
No text, logos, watermark, UI, website typography, crowns, sunglasses, jewelry displays, fake credentials, collage or extra people. ONE standalone portrait, vertical 2:3, high resolution.
Wardrobe: deep charcoal-black three-piece suit with broad refined peak lapels, matching waistcoat clearly visible, matching trousers, white shirt and charcoal tie.
Pose and composition: seated diagonally on a minimal dark architectural armchair, torso slightly leaning forward in an engaged composed way, shoulders relaxed but confident, knees comfortably apart, one forearm resting on a thigh and the other hand on chair arm. Natural strong editorial pose, NOT crossed arms or holding both lapels, NOT a passport-photo posture. Head turned back toward camera, eyes looking directly into lens. Camera close to eye level with a subtly lower viewpoint, never a distorted low-angle selfie. Frame from full hair to just below knees; face remains large enough to recognize immediately.
Backdrop and art direction: minimal warm graphite studio with soft warm ivory spotlight gradient and a sculptural curved plaster wall softly out of focus. Understated champagne edge light on jacket, face neutrally lit. Quiet cinematic authority, carefully composed negative space, premium magazine portrait, natural human presence. The waistcoat, shoulders and face must be visually prominent.
